question.text: There are three types of Clearing Members in India's Exchange-Traded Currency Derivatives market. Which of the following Clearing Member types has ONLY clearing rights and NO trading rights?

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook states that Professional Clearing Members have only clearing rights and no trading rights. PCMs clear and settle trades executed by trading members and custodial participants. The Trap: A Trading cum Self-Clearing Member (SCM) clears and settles trades executed solely by itself, on own account or client account, but not for custodial participants. A Trading Cum Clearing Member (TCM) can clear for itself and for other trading members and custodial participants. Only the PCM is restricted to clearing. Note: SEBI-registered custodians and banks typically become PCMs, providing specialist clearing services to trading members who prefer to focus on order execution.
